scripts.dist: npm run build:cli && npm run build && electron-builder --dir && npm run test:packaged-binary
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:cli && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --publish never && npm run test:packaged-binary
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:cli && npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish never && npm run test:packaged-binary
scripts.test:worker: tsc --target ES2022 --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --outDir out/tests src/main/worker-client.ts && node --test tests/worker-client.test.cjs
scripts.dist:linux:dir: npm run build:cli && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --dir && npm run test:packaged-binary
scripts.test:updates: tsc --target ES2022 --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --outDir out/tests src/main/updates.ts && node --test tests/updates.test.cjs
